description: Candidate Creative Commons / public research sources for reaching 30 fine genres at 80% Top1. Audio must be verified and analyzed locally before becoming formal training data.

sources.name: MTG-Jamendo Dataset
sources.licenseNote: Built from Jamendo tracks under Creative Commons licenses; per-track license is parsed from audio_licenses.txt.
sources.nextAction: Download or mount MTG-Jamendo audio-low outside the repo, then run cc-manifest:mtg-jamendo without MMFR_MTG_ALLOW_MISSING_AUDIO.

sources.name: Free Music Archive Dataset
sources.licenseNote: FMA is a Creative Commons music dataset; use real audio features for formal training, not FMA precomputed metadata vectors.
sources.nextAction: Resume Download FMA Small.command, unzip outside the repo, then run cc-import:fma against the FMA tracks.csv and audio root.

sources.name: Local curated CC audio folders
sources.licenseNote: Use only files with track-level license and reference URLs. The importer rejects repo-local audio and Artlist.
sources.nextAction: Place verified CC/public-research audio in genre-named folders on an external drive, generate a manifest with cc-manifest:from-folder, then import with cc-import.

sources.name: Internet Archive Creative Commons audio search
sources.licenseNote: Only use items with explicit Creative Commons license metadata and downloadable audio files; manually review before formal import.
sources.nextAction: Search by genre-specific terms, verify licenseurl and audio files, then download selected audio outside the repo.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons audio search
sources.licenseNote: Use only files with explicit Commons license metadata and downloadable audio MIME. Manually review the file page before formal import.
sources.nextAction: Collect Commons audio candidates, review file pages and licenses, then download selected audio outside the repo.

sources.name: Musopen public-domain / CC classical recordings
sources.licenseNote: Musopen focuses on public-domain and openly reusable classical recordings. Verify the recording-level license before import.
sources.nextAction: Download verified public-domain/CC recordings outside the repo, arrange them in genre-named folders, then generate a manifest with cc-manifest:from-folder.

sources.name: ccMixter Creative Commons remixes
sources.licenseNote: ccMixter hosts Creative Commons music, remix packs, and a cappellas. Verify track-level license and avoid stems-only rows unless the target genre is clear.
sources.nextAction: Curate complete tracks with clear genre labels and CC licenses, save audio outside the repo, then import via cc-manifest:from-folder.

sources.name: Freesound / FSD50K CC audio support set
sources.licenseNote: Freesound/FSD50K waveforms are Creative Commons, but many files are sound events rather than full music. Use only as support data for timbre/onset/noise traits, not as the main genre label source.
sources.nextAction: Use only reviewed clips that genuinely represent the target genre trait; mark datasetName clearly so they can be excluded from formal music-only evaluation if needed.

オペラ: opera public domain recording creative commons
